prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you have a specific type of work (kitchen/bath remodel, roof, siding, flooring, general handyman, electrical/plumbing, addition) and a target budget/timeline? That will let me give more targeted recommendations and a short list of contractors to contact.

Until then, here are practical, local steps and a vetting checklist so you find a reliable contractor in Joplin quickly:

How to find reputable local contractors
- Ask neighbors, friends, or your HOA for recent referrals — seeing finished work in person is ideal.  
- Check Google Business profiles and recent reviews for businesses in Joplin.  
- Use industry directories: Better Business Bureau (BBB), Angi, Houzz, HomeAdvisor.  
- Post your project in local community groups (Facebook “Joplin” groups, Nextdoor) asking for recent recommendations.  
- Contact the Joplin Chamber of Commerce for member contractors or check local hardware stores (they often know reputable subs).

Vet contractors before hiring
- Get at least 3 written estimates that break down labor, materials, permits, and timeline.  
- Verify insurance: ask for a Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming you as certificate holder and confirming general liability and worker’s comp (if they have employees).  
- Check licensing: Missouri doesn’t require a general contractor license statewide, but confirm any specialized trades (electrical, plumbing, HVAC) are licensed with the Missouri Division of Professional Registration.  
- Ask for references for projects similar in size/scope (call at least 2). Visit or view photos of completed jobs.  
- Check BBB and online reviews for patterns (not just one-off complaints).  
- Confirm who will pull permits (contractor should do this unless agreed otherwise).  
- Require a written contract detailing scope, materials, start/finish dates, payment schedule, change-order procedure, and warranty.  
- Avoid large up-front payments (common practice: a small deposit, progress payments, final payment on completion and final lien releases).

Questions to ask a contractor
- How long have you worked in Joplin area?  
- Can you provide 3 recent local references?  
- Are you insured and do you carry worker’s comp? Can I see COI?  
- Who will supervise the job each day? Will subcontractors be used?  
- Who pulls permits and manages inspections?  
- What is your projected start date, duration, and daily work hours?  
- What is included in the written contract and warranty?

Red flags
- Demands for large cash-only upfront payment.  
- No written contract or unwillingness to put details in writing.  
- Vague answers on licensing/insurance or no COI.  
- Strong high-pressure sales tactics or “special price if you sign today.”  
- Very low bid compared to others without explanation — could mean cutting corners or change orders later.

Sample message to send when requesting an estimate
Hello — I’m requesting an estimate for [brief project description: e.g., full bathroom remodel, replace roof, kitchen cabinets + flooring]. Project location: Joplin, MO. Desired start window: [dates]. Please send: a written estimate with cost breakdown (labor/materials), project timeline, names of any subcontractors, proof of insurance, and 3 references for similar local jobs. Thank you — [your name / contact info].

If you want, tell me:
- the type of project, approximate budget, and when you want it started — I’ll draft a short RFP for you and list the top places to search in Joplin and exact questions to give the contractors.
